notes: PRT writer: bit-spread tone encoding. Dense bits were packed into the first n 2-bit groups of each word, so rows with n<=3 were empty and rows with n>=5 were full - a 4-row pattern that printed as vertical bands. Dense bits are now distributed across all 8 sub-row groups with an x-dependent phase, and the dither mask phase follows the source row instead of restarting per block.
